expected: the candidate contains the base named by --base: the freshly fetched integration branch locally, the pull-request base under pull_request, and github.event.merge_group.base_sha under merge_group
remediation: Locally, fetch the integration branch, rebase the candidate onto it, and pass it as --base. In the lane the base comes from the event; a blocked probe under merge_group means the queue base is not an ancestor of the entry, so the entry is evicted and re-enters the queue from a green head instead of being retried.

expected: no tracked or untracked change is pending
remediation: Commit or remove every pending change so the candidate is exactly the commit under review.

expected: node major, pnpm version, and git major match .devai/config/toolchain.json
remediation: Install the node major, pnpm version, and git major declared in .devai/config/toolchain.json.
